import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int base_k;
    static long total_n;

    static class Vec {
        long[] data = new long[30];
    }

    static class Mat {
        long[][] mat = new long[30][30];
    }

    static Mat[] matrices_arr = new Mat[30];
    static Mat[] inv_matrices_arr = new Mat[30];
    static Mat[][] E_matrices = new Mat[200][40], EI_matrices = new Mat[200][40];
    static Vec current_vec = new Vec();

    static long getVal(long num) {
        if (num < base_k) return num;
        return (num + getVal(num / base_k)) % base_k;
    }

    static Mat multiply_matrices(Mat a, Mat b) {
        Mat res = new Mat();
        for (int i = 0; i < base_k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < base_k; j++) {
                res.mat[i][j] = 0;
                for (int l = 0; l < base_k; l++) {
                    res.mat[i][j] += (a.mat[i][l] * b.mat[l][j]) % MOD;
                }
                res.mat[i][j] %= MOD;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static Vec multiply_matrix_vector(Mat m, Vec v) {
        Vec res = new Vec();
        for (int i = 0; i < base_k; i++) {
            res.data[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < base_k; j++) {
                res.data[i] += (v.data[j] * m.mat[i][j]) % MOD;
            }
            res.data[i] %= MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void precompute_matrices() {
        for (int i = 0; i < base_k; i++) {
            E_matrices[0][i] = matrices_arr[i];
            EI_matrices[0][i] = inv_matrices_arr[i];
        }
        int LOG = 0;
        long t = total_n;
        while (t > 0) {
            LOG++;
            t /= base_k;
        }
        for (int j = 1; j <= LOG; j++) {
            E_matrices[j][0] = E_matrices[j - 1][0];
            EI_matrices[j][0] = EI_matrices[j - 1][0];
            for (int l = 1; l < base_k; l++) {
                E_matrices[j][0] = multiply_matrices(E_matrices[j - 1][l], E_matrices[j][0]);
                EI_matrices[j][0] = multiply_matrices(EI_matrices[j][0], EI_matrices[j - 1][l]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < base_k; i++) {
                E_matrices[j][i] = multiply_matrices(E_matrices[j - 1][i - 1], multiply_matrices(E_matrices[j][i - 1], EI_matrices[j - 1][i - 1]));
                EI_matrices[j][i] = multiply_matrices(E_matrices[j - 1][i - 1], multiply_matrices(EI_matrices[j][i - 1], EI_matrices[j - 1][i - 1]));
            }
        }
    }

    static Vec solve_vector(long n, Vec v, int at) {
        if (n == 0) return v;
        int w = (int) getVal(n / base_k);
        v = solve_vector(n / base_k, v, at + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n % base_k; i++) {
            v = multiply_matrix_vector(E_matrices[at][(w + i) % base_k], v);
        }
        return v;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        total_n = sc.nextLong();
        base_k = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < base_k; i++) {
            current_vec.data[i] = 1;
            matrices_arr[i] = new Mat();
            inv_matrices_arr[i] = new Mat();
            for (int j = 0; j < base_k; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < base_k; l++) {
                    if (j == l) {
                        matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 1;
                        inv_matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 1;
                    } else if (j == i) {
                        matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 1;
                        inv_matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = -1;
                    } else {
                        matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 0;
                        inv_matrices_arr[i].mat[j][l] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        precompute_matrices();
        current_vec = solve_vector(total_n, current_vec, 0);
        long total_sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < base_k; i++) {
            total_sum += current_vec.data[i];
        }
        total_sum--;
        total_sum %= MOD;
        if (total_sum < 0) total_sum += MOD;
        while (total_sum % (base_k - 1) != 0) {
            total_sum += MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(total_sum / (base_k - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
